# AMC Brutal Block

<!-- Generated by tools/build-templates.mjs from template.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Region Template** for Universal Theme · direction: bold · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

A neo-brutalist region: thick ink border, hard offset shadow, a flat striped palette band and the title in a tilted sticker label that breaks out of the top edge.

**Use it for:** Regions that should shout on internal tools and admin pages: a work queue Classic Report, a checklist Form, a Chart on a status board or a Static Content notice.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, through the Builder):** App Builder > your app > Shared Components >
  Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_tpl_brutal_block.sql` (Component Export). It creates the
  template in Universal Theme and its Static Application File(s) in `amc-templates/`.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/region-templates/amc-brutal-block.apx` and
  `dist/apexlang/shared-components/static-files/amc-templates/` into the app, add the entries from
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx` to `shared-components/static-files.apx`, then run the apexlang gates.

## Use

On any region, set **Appearance > Template** to **AMC Brutal Block**. In APEXlang: `appearance { template: @amc-brutal-block }`.

Region template in neo-brutalist style. The ink border and hard shadow use the theme text color, so they invert in dark styles; the shadow falls to the end side and flips in right-to-left pages. The title and icon sit in a tilted label that breaks out of the top edge; Help, Edit, Change, Copy, Delete and Create buttons sit in the header band, Previous, Close and Next in the footer. Template options color the band warning, success, danger or ink, move the shadow to the start side, or remove the body padding. The label straightens and the shadow grows while the region has hover or keyboard focus; under reduced motion the change is instant. In forced-colors mode the shadow is removed and the borders use system colors.

## Template options

| Option | Class | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Warning band | `amc-TBrutalBlock--warning` | Header band in the warning palette color, for caution notices and pending work. |
| Success band | `amc-TBrutalBlock--success` | Header band in the success palette color. |
| Danger band | `amc-TBrutalBlock--danger` | Header band in the danger palette color, for blockers and escalations. |
| Ink band | `amc-TBrutalBlock--ink` | Solid ink header band with the label as a light sticker on top; the strongest variant. |
| Shadow to start side | `amc-TBrutalBlock--shadowStart` | Moves the hard shadow to the start side, for regions in an end-side column. |
| No body padding | `amc-TBrutalBlock--noPadding` | Removes body padding so reports run edge to edge inside the ink border. |
